text:
maya: Heads-up — while onboarding the new open-gpt-small model I hit degenerate repetitions even though the HF generation_config.json had repetition_penalty: 1.0. Suspect our HF->Redwood mapping applied different defaults.

liam: Can you paste the original generation_config.json and the Redwood-converted params? Also which quantization did you run?

maya: pasted below from the model repo:```json
{
  "do_sample": false,
  "temperature": 0.0,
  "top_k": 50,
  "top_p": 1.0,
  "repetition_penalty": 1.0
}
```
Converted by our importer it became (from the conversion log):```yaml
rw_gen: 
  do_sample: true  # <-- suspicious
  temperature: 1.0 # HF had 0.0, importer defaulted
  top_k: 50
  top_p: 1.0
  repetition_penalty: 1.2 # importer applied safety bump for quantized models
```
The combination of do_sample=true with temp=1.0 + rep_penalty bump explains the noisy repeats we saw.

sara: That rep_penalty bump is something we added ages ago for int8 models (safety fallback) but it shouldn't be applied if HF explicitly set rep_penalty. Looks like the converter treats 1.0 as "unset" when do_sample=false. Bug.

oliver: Also double-check tokenizer special tokens — I saw another run where missing pad_token caused the model to repeatedly emit <unk> or BOS-like tokens during quantized decode. Did you confirm vocab/special_tokens.json was loaded?

maya: Yep verified tokenizer has:```json
{
  "bos_token": "<s>",
  "eos_token": "</s>",
  "pad_token": "<pad>"
}
```
So specials look fine. This one is purely gen-config mapping. Quantization used static int8 (GPTQ-style), but the main regression is present even on fp16 after importer mapping.

liam: Quick repro plan: 1) run HF native generation with the repo config (do_sample=false, temp=0.0) -> save output; 2) import to Redwood but force keep-original-flags flag -> run same prompt and compare token sequences + log sampling RNG. If importer is flipping do_sample or temp, we should see stochastic differences immediately.

dev-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started for model open-gpt-small at 2025-11-02T09:12:00Z on rw-dedicated-01 (canary policy: 5% traffic).

maya: Ran step 1 vs step 2 locally. Deterministic HF run produced identical completions across seeds. Redwood-imported run showed variations and occasional repeats. I collected a short diff:```diff
- deterministic HF: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog."
+ imported RW: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. The quick brown fox jumps..."
```

qa-bot: Note: internal eval job eval-20251102-17 shows ~3.8% drop in ROUGE-L when importer defaults are applied. Job: https://internal/evals/exec/eval-20251102-17 (perm link)

sara: Proposed fixes: 1) Treat explicit HF fields (even if temp=0.0 or do_sample=false) as authoritative and do not override. 2) Avoid rep_penalty bump unless model-tag contains "quantized:true" AND rep_penalty was unset. 3) Add unit test that converts HF genconfig with do_sample=false and temp=0.0 and asserts rw_gen.do_sample==false.

oliver: I'll own the unit test + conversion patch. maya can you open a short PR with sample configs and the failing golden outputs? Put acceptance tests under eng-ml/tests/hf-converter/ so CI can run.

maya: Will do. One more gotcha I noticed: chat templates that map role sequences (system/user/assistant) sometimes strip out a trailing user turn which changes prefix length and can flip kernel selection (attention window) — small change but can affect quantized kernels and cause subtle deltas. Log that as follow-up.

liam: Good call. Add that to the issue (GH #open) and tag eng-runtime for kernel/quantization sensitivity.

maya: Action items: maya -> PR with reproducer/configs, oliver -> conversion unit test + patch, sara -> update policy for rep_penalty bump, liam -> run CI eval job once patch lands.

oliver: I'll aim for a draft PR today. Thanks for catching this! :thumbsup:
